name: loto-info-sheet
description: A progressive web app (PWA) for field data collection of Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) information. Built for technicians to document equipment details, energy sources, capture photos, and annotate overhead diagrams directly from mobile devices — fully offline-capable.

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html FingerLakes_Information_Sheet.html sw.js manifest.json manifest_fl.json www/
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
